name: Tech Support Repair Shop
place: A computer and phone repair shop
speaker: Technician

tasks.goal: Greet the technician and state your purpose
tasks.hint: State your main purpose clearly upon arrival.
tasks.done_when: Learner greeted the technician and stated purpose.

tasks.goal: Describe smartphone screen damage after a accidental drop
tasks.hint: Explain the physical issue with your device.
tasks.done_when: Learner described phone screen damage.

tasks.goal: Inquire about estimated repair cost and replacement parts
tasks.hint: Ask for a price quote for fixing the device.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about repair cost and part availability.

tasks.goal: Ask if battery replacement is recommended for poor battery health
tasks.hint: Inquire if replacing the battery will improve performance.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about battery replacement options.
tasks.scene_hint: Whirring cooling fans and electronic diagnostic beeps fill the workspace.

tasks.goal: Ask how long diagnostic testing will take
tasks.hint: Inquire about repair turnaround time.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about diagnostic test duration.

tasks.goal: Use the word 'warranty'
tasks.hint: Warranty is repair coverage. Ask if the repair includes a warranty.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'warranty'.

tasks.goal: Inquire whether personal data needs to be wiped before repair
tasks.hint: Ask about data privacy and backup precautions.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about data backup and wiping procedures.

tasks.goal: Negotiate expedited repair service due to urgent work needs
tasks.hint: Politely ask if same-day repair service is possible.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested expedited repair service.

tasks.goal: Ask if liquid damage indicator was triggered inside the phone
tasks.hint: Inquire if internal water damage was detected.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about liquid damage detection.

tasks.goal: Express concern over high repair estimate and ask for alternative options
tasks.hint: Respond to a costly quote by asking for refurbished parts.
tasks.done_when: Learner expressed concern over repair quote and asked for alternatives.
tasks.scene_hint: Tiny screwdrivers and disassembled circuit boards rest on anti-static mats.

tasks.goal: Ask if a temporary loaner device is available during repair
tasks.hint: Inquire if you can borrow a phone while yours is serviced.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about loaner device availability.

tasks.goal: Confirm repair warranty duration on replaced screen component
tasks.hint: Verify coverage length for installed spare parts.
tasks.done_when: Learner confirmed repair warranty coverage terms.

tasks.goal: Request a written claim receipt with device serial number
tasks.hint: Ask for official claim documentation to collect the device later.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested a repair claim receipt with serial number.

tasks.goal: Verify accepted payment options upon picking up repaired device
tasks.hint: Confirm if credit cards or contactless payments are accepted.
tasks.done_when: Learner verified payment methods upon device collection.

tasks.goal: Thank the technician and bid farewell
tasks.hint: Express gratitude and close the conversation.
tasks.done_when: Learner thanked the technician AND said goodbye.

tasks.goal: Describe device symptom such as laptop screen flickering
tasks.hint: Explain primary technical issue clearly to technician.
tasks.done_when: Learner described specific device problem symptoms.

tasks.goal: Specify device make model and operating system version
tasks.hint: Provide device details when submitting for repair.
tasks.done_when: Learner specified device model and operating system.

tasks.goal: Inquire about initial diagnostic assessment timeframe
tasks.hint: Ask how many hours required to inspect device issue.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about time needed for diagnostic evaluation.

tasks.goal: Verify estimated cost of replacement hardware components
tasks.hint: Ask technician total price breakdown for parts and labor.
tasks.done_when: Learner verified parts and labor repair estimate.

tasks.goal: Confirm data protection and privacy during repair process
tasks.hint: Ask technician how personal files are kept secure.
tasks.done_when: Learner confirmed data privacy procedures during repair.

tasks.goal: Ask if replaced broken parts will be returned to customer
tasks.hint: Inquire if old damaged components can be collected after repair.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked if replaced hardware parts will be returned.

tasks.goal: Request SMS notification when device repair is completed
tasks.hint: Ask shop to send text message when device is ready.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested text message notification upon repair completion.

tasks.goal: Verify repair warranty coverage period on newly installed battery
tasks.hint: Ask how many months guarantee applies to replacement part.
tasks.done_when: Learner verified warranty duration for replacement part.

tasks.goal: Confirm accepted payment methods for completed repair bill
tasks.hint: Ask if credit card or mobile wallet is accepted at pickup counter.
tasks.done_when: Learner confirmed payment options at repair shop counter.

tasks.goal: Use the word 'diagnostic'
tasks.hint: Diagnostic means technical test. Ask if diagnostic test fee is refundable.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'diagnostic'.

tasks.goal: Use the word 'motherboard'
tasks.hint: Motherboard is main circuit board. Ask if liquid damage reached motherboard.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'motherboard'.

tasks.goal: Use the word 'backup'
tasks.hint: Backup means saving copy of files. Ask if full data backup is completed.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'backup'.

tasks.goal: Use the word 'refurbished'
tasks.hint: Refurbished means restored to working order. Ask if replacement screen is refurbished.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'refurbished'.

tasks.goal: Inquire if express same-day repair service is available
tasks.hint: Ask if paying extra expedites repair within four hours.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about express same-day repair service.

tasks.goal: Ask about liquid damage treatment success rates on smartphones
tasks.hint: Inquire if water-damaged phone can be fully restored.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about liquid damage recovery prospects.

tasks.goal: Report unexpected battery drain following recent system software update
tasks.hint: Explain that battery life dropped sharply after update.
tasks.done_when: Learner reported post-update battery drain issue.

tasks.goal: Request data recovery from unbootable external hard drive
tasks.hint: Ask technician if photos can be extracted from dead drive.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested file recovery from damaged storage drive.
tasks.scene_hint: Soldering station fumes waft softly near workbench covered with micro-screws.

tasks.goal: Ask for clarification regarding diagnostic fee waiver upon repair approval
tasks.hint: Ask if diagnostic fee is credited toward repair cost.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked if diagnostic fee applies toward final repair bill.

tasks.goal: Inquire if shop uses original manufacturer replacement parts
tasks.hint: Ask if replacement screens are genuine OEM components.
tasks.done_when: Learner inquired if genuine OEM replacement parts are used.

tasks.goal: Report overheating issue when running graphics intensive applications
tasks.hint: Explain device fan spins loudly and case gets hot.
tasks.done_when: Learner reported device overheating during high load.
tasks.scene_hint: Magnifying desk lamp illuminates circuit board being tested with multimeter.

tasks.goal: Ask if protective glass screen protector can be installed
tasks.hint: Inquire about screen protector installation service fee.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about adding tempered glass screen protector.

tasks.goal: Request extension of device holding period prior to pickup
tasks.hint: Ask shop to hold repaired laptop for extra three days.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested extended pickup holding period.

tasks.goal: Inquire about trade-in credit value for old broken tablet
tasks.hint: Ask if damaged device has trade-in residual value.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about trade-in value for old device.

tasks.goal: Ask for instructions on disabling passcode before leaving device
tasks.hint: Ask technician how to remove screen lock PIN for repair testing.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked how to remove screen passcode for diagnostic testing.
tasks.scene_hint: Shelves behind counter hold labeled anti-static bins containing customer laptops.

tasks.goal: Clarify policy on unclaimed devices after 60 days
tasks.hint: Ask what happens to devices left beyond pickup deadline.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about unclaimed device disposal policy.

tasks.goal: Inquire if shop offers loaner laptop while mine is in repair
tasks.hint: Ask if temporary computer is provided during long repair.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about loaner device availability during repair.

tasks.goal: Ask if thermal paste replacement improves processor cooling
tasks.hint: Inquire if refreshing CPU thermal compound lowers temperatures.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about processor thermal paste replacement.

tasks.goal: Request assistance transferring contacts to new replacement phone
tasks.hint: Ask technician to migrate phonebook data between devices.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested contact transfer assistance.
tasks.scene_hint: Whir of electric precision screwdriver unfastening laptop bottom chassis.

tasks.goal: Inquire about custom gaming PC assembly build services
tasks.hint: Ask if shop builds custom desktop computers from parts.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about custom PC assembly build service.

tasks.goal: Report loose charging port connector that disconnects easily
tasks.hint: Explain power cable must be wiggled to charge battery.
tasks.done_when: Learner reported loose charging port connection.

tasks.goal: Confirm whether malware removal includes installing antivirus software
tasks.hint: Ask if computer clean-up package includes security software.
tasks.done_when: Learner confirmed antivirus inclusion in malware cleaning package.
tasks.scene_hint: Blue anti-static mat covers wooden repair desk lined with magnetic trays.

tasks.goal: Ask if shop repairs vintage retro gaming consoles
tasks.hint: Inquire about repair capabilities for older electronics.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about retro console repair services.

tasks.goal: Request price estimate for upgrading RAM memory capacity
tasks.hint: Ask how much adding sixteen gigabytes memory costs.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested price quote for RAM memory upgrade.

tasks.goal: Inquire about water resistance rating post screen replacement
tasks.hint: Ask if IP rating seal is restored after opening phone case.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked if device retains water resistance after repair.

tasks.goal: Ask if keyboard keycap can be replaced individually without full top case
tasks.hint: Negotiate replacing single key instead of whole keyboard.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about individual keyboard key replacement.

tasks.goal: Report speaker sound distortion at high volume levels
tasks.hint: Point out crackling audio output during sound test.
tasks.done_when: Learner reported speaker audio distortion.
tasks.scene_hint: Digital oscilloscope screen displays square wave signals in green phosphor lines.

tasks.goal: Ask for recommendation on reliable cloud backup services
tasks.hint: Inquire which online storage platform technician recommends.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked for cloud backup service recommendations.

tasks.goal: Request demonstration of touch screen responsiveness after repair
tasks.hint: Ask technician to demonstrate multi-touch gestures on fixed screen.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested touch screen responsiveness test.
tasks.scene_hint: Rack of battery charging stations with LED indicators glowing green and red.

tasks.goal: Confirm whether repair estimate includes state sales tax
tasks.hint: Ask if quoted price includes tax and recycling environmental fees.
tasks.done_when: Learner verified tax inclusion in repair estimate.

tasks.goal: Ask if shop offers student discounts on labor charges
tasks.hint: Inquire if university ID qualifies for percentage discount.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about student discount on repair labor.

tasks.goal: Inquire about firmware update flashing services for bricked device
tasks.hint: Ask if non-booting device firmware can be restored.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about firmware reflashing for unbootable device.

tasks.goal: Report camera lens glass scratch affecting photo clarity
tasks.hint: Point out blurry spot on test photos due to scratched lens.
tasks.done_when: Learner reported camera lens scratch defect.
tasks.scene_hint: Heat gun clicks off after softening adhesive on tablet display frame.

tasks.goal: Ask if device serial number is recorded on intake receipt
tasks.hint: Check receipt to confirm serial number matches device.
tasks.done_when: Learner verified device serial number recorded on receipt.

tasks.goal: Inquire about remote desktop tech support options for software issues
tasks.hint: Ask if technician can fix software bugs over internet.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about remote software support services.

tasks.goal: Request extra USB charging cable with braided nylon cord
tasks.hint: Ask to purchase durable charging cable at counter.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested purchase of braided USB cable.
tasks.scene_hint: Plastic bin containing recycled electronics cables and power adapters.

tasks.goal: Ask about policy on accidental data loss during motherboard swap
tasks.hint: Inquire liability terms if hard drive data is corrupted during repair.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about liability policies regarding data loss during repair.

tasks.goal: Clarify procedure for checking repair status online
tasks.hint: Ask for web tracking URL and work order code.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked how to track repair progress online.

tasks.goal: Inquire about bulk repair discounts for company laptops
tasks.hint: Ask if business client accounts receive lower service rates.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about commercial bulk repair rates.

tasks.goal: Report non-responsive power button that requires hard press
tasks.hint: Point out stiff power switch mechanism.
tasks.done_when: Learner reported malfunctioning power button switch.
tasks.scene_hint: Ultrasonic cleaning bath hums while cleaning corroded circuit boards.

tasks.goal: Ask if shop sells recycled refurbished laptops with warranty
tasks.hint: Inquire about inventory of certified pre-owned computers.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about purchasing refurbished computers.

tasks.goal: Request technician advice on extending lithium battery lifespan
tasks.hint: Ask how to optimize charging habits to preserve battery health.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested battery health preservation advice.

tasks.goal: Inquire about liquid metal thermal cooling upgrades for gaming laptops
tasks.hint: Ask if premium liquid metal cooling compound can be applied.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about liquid metal cooling installation.

tasks.goal: Ask if shop accepts old dead batteries for safe recycling
tasks.hint: Inquire if battery disposal bin is available for public use.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about battery recycling collection services.

tasks.goal: Request assistance setting up dual monitor display settings
tasks.hint: Ask technician to configure display settings for two monitors.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested help setting up dual monitor configuration.
